check.description: Pointer targets are at least 44x44 CSS px (or equivalent/inline/essential exceptions). The Apollo hit-area standard target/min=44px (RULED 2026-07-24) is this AAA bar; _validate_hit_area.py is its consumer.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).
